```{r, include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = TRUE,
	warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```

Load key packages

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(httr)
```

## Scraping

Import NSDUH data

```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html =
  read_html(url)
```

```{r}
marj_df =
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |> 
  slice(-1)
```

Import Star Wars data

```{r}
swm_html = 
  read_html_live("https://www.imdb.com/list/ls070150896/")
```

Now pull out elements of the html that I care about.

```{r}
swm_title_vec = 
  swm_html |> 
  html_elements(".ipc-title-link-wrapper .ipc-title__text") |> 
  html_text()

swm_metascore_vec = 
  swm_html |> 
  html_elements(".metacritic-score-box") |> 
  html_text()

swm_runtime_vec = 
  swm_html |> 
  html_elements(".dli-title-metadata-item:nth-child(2)") |> 
  html_text()

sw_df = 
  tibble(
    title = swm_title_vec,
    metascore = swm_metascore_vec,
    runtime = swm_runtime_vec
  )
```
